concerns.text: The plan cites AFLOWlib as a data source but provides no verified URL or formal citation block (e.g., a ‘Verified Datasets’ entry). Constitution Principle II requires every external dataset to be verified; the lack of a reachable, cited URL makes this dataset citation non‑compliant.

The feature‑engineering description computes an ‘atomic_size_mismatch’ (standard deviation of atomic radii) whereas the specification (FR‑002) calls for the ‘atomic size coefficient of variation’ (σ/μ). This inconsistency should be resolved to match the required descriptor definition.
